hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $9$ are $1, 3,$ and $9.$

$9$ has $3$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $37$ are $1$ and $37.$

$37$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $38$ are $1, 2, 19,$ and $38.$

$38$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $65$ are $1, 5, 13,$ and $65.$

$65$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $81$ are $1, 3, 9, 27,$ and $81.$

$81$ has $5$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
